766760101.text: Well done, everyone! I must say, this exchange has been absolute perfection so far!

766760102.text: Quite a few of our friends from Sumeru have learned our styles of dance... I can already see our dances spreading across Teyvat!

766760103.text: I hope we can take turns to visit each other and make this dance exchange a regular tradition in the future!

766760104.text: So, will the saurians of Natlan be able to do blade-dances like The Eremites do?

766760107.text: Huh? Are you talking about the intimidating actions that Uncle Scimitar and the others used to scare off the Consecrated Red Vultures the first time Nusta met him?

766760108.text: Did he not tell you where those movements are from?

766760109.text: Yeah, he did. What did he call that dance...? "The Duet of Flame-Mane and Heron's Guard"? I like that name — conveys both grace and power!

766760110.text: Ooh, those two names sounds familiar!
